entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Aww yeeeaaaah! The Treasure has[n]appeared!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, it's huge!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What do you think!? It's just as I said![n]Now we can steal it!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Ahh... this shine brings tears to my eyes...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...It kinda pisses me off.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Why's it so pretty? Isn't this Kamoshida's[n]desires?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: T-Treasure...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh, the cat's actin' awfully excited.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What's wrong? Is something...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Meeeeeooooow!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Mrrrrroooooow!
You're way too excited.
That's not catnip...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Meow, meow! Mewwwww!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right, that's enough, you stupid cat!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh, um, yeah... Forgive me for displaying[n]such an insolent sight in front of a lady...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You were completely out of character too.[n]What was that about?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I couldn't stop it either... To think I'd be[n]drawn to human desires this much...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Doesn't that prove that I'm human!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: How should we know!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: A-Anyway, you guys need to carry it!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All you do is bark orders...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Still, that was easier than I thought![n]I thought for sure there'd be some[n]insane trap or something.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: His Palace will disappear if we take this[n]back, right?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And Kamoshida will change too...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...That should be the case.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Good. Now's our chance then.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's heavy...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: To think it'd go so well... I've even found[n]three Persona-users in the process...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: My judgment was correct. I made the right[n]choice in making a deal with you!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Nyahaha!
I feel like my bond with[n]Morgana is growing deeper...
